speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: We are concerned about disempowering the parties to a matrimonial proceeding, which is also inconsistent with our intent to secure the best interest of the parties and their children.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: Instead, a therapeutic justice approach helps couples to move forward in a more positive way, rather than positioning parties as adversaries in Court.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: The other party may return to Court and apply to vary the order.
